summary: Message inbox reads conversations + bodies from Stream Chat (getstream.io); replaces the generated GetMessageThread stub. Sends still route through care.com's moderated sendCareNeedMessage.
reason: care.com messaging does not run on the GraphQL BFF; the inbox lives on Stream Chat, so reviewing applicant conversations requires the page-embedded Stream token and Stream's REST API.
validated_outcome: messages inbox returned real conversations + bodies live; reply routes through the moderated send path with a dry-run default.
